title: Izwi Elivela Kwalasha
intro: Indaba yokubekezela kanye nomusa ongenamkhawulo woNkulunkulu ivele kwiQuran. Isithunywa sathunyelwa edolobheni elikhulu, kodwa abantu babo benqaba isixwayiso futhi benqaba iqiniso. Ngokukhungatheka, lo mphefumulo wahamba - ukuze uvivinywe ulwandle oluvuthayo futhi ugwinywe ekujuleni kobumnyama. Kusukela esiswini sobumnyama, kwavela isicelo esithobekile, futhi uSomandla onesihe waphendula. Ubani lo mphefumulo owavela uguqulwe, obantu bawo babezoba amakholwa angaphezu kwezinkulungwane eziyikhulu?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengomxwayisi edolobheni elikhulu elinabantu abaphambukile endleleni yokholo.
Ngibize abantu bami eqinisweni ngokuphindaphindiwe, kodwa bahleka usulu futhi benqaba isigijimi sami.
Ngasuka kubo ngikhungathekile ngaphambi kokuba ngithole imvume, ngaqonda olwandle oluvulekile.
Kwavela isiphepho esikhulu, ngaphonswa olwandle — ngabe sengigwinywa yisidalwa esikhulu sasolwandle.

Ezingqimbeni zobumnyama — ekujuleni kolwandle, esiswini sesidalwa, kanye nasezansi kolwandle — ngamemeza ngathi: ‘Akukho nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho; udumo malube kuwe; ngangiphakathi kwabenzi bobubi.’
U-Allah wangikhulula ekujuleni, futhi lapho ngibuya, abantu bami abangaphezu kwezinkulungwane eziyikhulu base bamukele iqiniso.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
